<Video 1> = 原版三段式参考视频（地图破图 + 3D 弹出 + 实景切换，15.1 秒）
<Subject 1> = 基于 <Picture 1> 锁定的女主（全程一致性）
================================================================


[1] subject_definitions

<Subject 1> is a young European woman in her early twenties with soft natural blonde wavy hair falling past her shoulders, fair porcelain skin with subtle natural blush, light blue-green eyes, soft pink lips, gentle warm smile, wearing minimal gold jewelry (small hoop earrings and a delicate gold necklace). Her facial features and overall look are strictly consistent with <Picture 1> across all shots. She has a chic, modern European aesthetic — minimal makeup, natural radiance, and an effortless traveler vibe.


[2] summary

A 15-second vertical travel vlog for Shorts/Reels/TikTok that follows <Subject 1> on a whirlwind global journey through four iconic landmarks — the Colosseum in Rome, the Pyramids of Giza in Egypt, Mount Fuji in Japan, and the Statue of Liberty in New York. The video repeats the signature "Google Maps pin breaking through to a 3D landmark popping up" transition, then cuts to a cinematic real-scene portrait of <Subject 1> at each location. Each real-scene segment gets a relaxed 2.25 seconds with gentle camera movement, while map/3D segments are quick 1.5-second beats. The pacing is rhythmic and aspirational, with bright cheerful electronic pop music driving the cuts. The color palette progresses from warm terracotta-amber (Rome) to golden desert (Egypt) to sakura-pink alpine blue (Fuji) to cool harbor blue (New York).


[3] retention_analysis

Throughout the 15-second video, <Subject 1>'s facial identity, hair color, skin tone, and overall styling must remain strictly consistent with <Picture 1>. Her outfit changes per destination but her face, hair, and jewelry remain identical across all eight shots. The "map pin breaking through to 3D landmark" transition motion is inherited from <Video 1> and must appear identically in shots 1, 3, 5, and 7. The "camera descending from landmark to subject in real scene" reveal motion is also inherited from <Video 1> and must appear in shots 2, 4, 6, and 8. The landmarks and outfits change, but the structural rhythm of "map → 3D → real scene" must remain exactly the same as in <Video 1>.


[4] detailed_description

[Shot 1 — 0.0s to 1.5s] Top-down close-up of a Google Maps interface showing Rome, Italy. A feminine hand enters the frame, pulls out a red pin planted on the Colosseum coordinates. The map surface cracks open like shattered glass, and a detailed 3D model of the Colosseum rises through the broken surface. Bright clean blue-white UI tone. Pop sound effect on pin pull, sharp glass-crack sound effect on map break.

[Shot 2 — 1.5s to 3.75s] Hard cut. The camera descends from the 3D Colosseum into a real cinematic travel scene at the Roman Forum at golden hour. The actual Colosseum stands in the background. <Subject 1> wears a breezy cream linen sundress, a woven straw tote bag, and her gold necklace, strolling along a sunlit stone path. She turns toward the camera with a warm smile, the camera gently pushing in. Warm terracotta-amber lighting, soft dust haze in the air. Cheerful pop music continues.

[Shot 3 — 3.75s to 5.25s] Hard cut back to top-down Google Maps view, now showing Giza, Egypt. A feminine hand pulls out a red pin planted on the Pyramids coordinates. The map surface cracks open, and a detailed 3D model of the Great Pyramid of Giza rises through the broken surface. Bright clean blue-white UI tone. Pin-pull and glass-crack sound effects repeat.

[Shot 4 — 5.25s to 7.5s] Hard cut. The camera descends from the 3D pyramid into a real cinematic travel scene in the Sahara desert at Giza. <Subject 1> wears a flowing white caftan, a thin gold arm cuff, and oversized sunglasses, a light desert scarf trailing in the wind. Behind her: the Great Pyramids under a vast blue sky. She turns slowly, scarf drifting, and smiles at the camera. The camera slowly pans across the dunes. Golden desert sunlight, high contrast white sand and deep blue sky. Cheerful pop music continues.

[Shot 5 — 7.5s to 9.0s] Hard cut back to top-down Google Maps view, now showing Mount Fuji, Japan. A feminine hand pulls out a red pin planted on the Fuji coordinates. The map surface cracks open, and a detailed 3D model of snow-capped Mount Fuji rises through the broken surface. Bright clean blue-white UI tone. Pin-pull and glass-crack sound effects repeat.

[Shot 6 — 9.0s to 11.25s] Hard cut. The camera descends from the 3D Fuji into a real cinematic travel scene at a lakeside with cherry blossoms. <Subject 1> wears a pastel-pink knit cardigan over a white pleated skirt, holding a small pink parasol, standing among falling sakura petals. Behind her: the majestic snow-capped Mount Fuji reflected in the calm lake. She twirls gently, petals drifting around her, then looks back at the camera. The camera slowly arcs. Soft spring light, sakura-pink and alpine-blue tones. Cheerful pop music continues.

[Shot 7 — 11.25s to 12.75s] Hard cut back to top-down Google Maps view, now showing New York City, USA. A feminine hand pulls out a red pin planted on the Statue of Liberty coordinates. The map surface cracks open, and a detailed 3D model of the Statue of Liberty rises through the broken surface. Bright clean blue-white UI tone. Pin-pull and glass-crack sound effects repeat.

[Shot 8 — 12.75s to 15.0s] Hard cut. The camera descends from the 3D Statue of Liberty into a real cinematic travel scene at New York Harbor. <Subject 1> wears a light denim jacket over a white tee, a navy "NYC" baseball cap, and her gold necklace, holding a takeaway coffee cup. Behind her: the Statue of Liberty on her pedestal and the harbor skyline. She walks toward the camera along the pier, then raises her coffee in a cheerful toast and smiles. The camera follows. Cool harbor-blue lighting, crisp afternoon sun. Pop music fades out with a camera shutter click, ending the video at 15.0s.


[5] overall_soundscape

Throughout the video: a clean, bright, modern soundscape. During the map/3D transition shots (1, 3, 5, 7): sharp digital UI sound effects — finger pin pull, glass crack, and a subtle whoosh as the 3D model rises. During the real-scene shots (2, 4, 6, 8): light ambient atmosphere — soft Roman breeze and distant city murmur, desert wind over the dunes, gentle lakeside wind through cherry blossoms, harbor waves and distant ferry horn. No dialogue, no narration, no on-screen text anywhere in the video.


[6] non_diegetic_music

A bright, upbeat, modern electronic pop instrumental BGM with a rhythmic beat pattern matching the cuts. The tempo is approximately 120 BPM, with bright synth chimes, light hand claps, and a punchy bassline. The music drives each shot transition with a downbeat. The volume stays constant through shots 1–7, then fades smoothly to silence during shot 8, ending exactly with a single crisp camera shutter click sound at the final frame (15.0s).
